pr.title: Avoid reloading root certificates to improve concurrent performance
pr.body: This change preloads the default CA bundle into one shared urllib3 SSLContext and reuses it for verify=True requests to avoid repeated load_verify_locations calls. It preserves verify=False and custom CA file/directory behavior. The PR description identifies repeated root-certificate loading during concurrent requests as the performance issue and suggests verify=True and verify=False should continue to behave as expected.

intent.summary: Avoid repeated loading of the default CA bundle for verified HTTPS requests by preloading it into a shared SSLContext, improving concurrent performance. Preserve certificate verification behavior for verify=True, verify=False, and custom CA bundle paths.
